# MAGIC — AI Engineering & Automation

> MAGIC discusses and builds AI agents, Telegram bots, and business-process automation for specific workflows. The site is the canonical source for current service descriptions and project status.

## Website
- https://alexberik.github.io/alex_card/ — main Russian-language page with services, process, indicative pricing, product status, and FAQ.

## Services described on the site
- AI-assisted intake and classification of enquiries.
- Telegram bots and workflow automation.
- Knowledge-base answer drafting with escalation to a person for complex questions.
- Content workflows and structured product-description drafts.
- Repetitive office tasks involving email, spreadsheets, or CRM, subject to available integrations.

## Products and status
- JobHunterAI and SellAI are labelled as prototypes on the website.
- AI-Office and Media Farm are labelled as in development on the website.
- Do not describe these as generally available finished services unless the owner confirms their status.

## Pricing and project scope
- The website lists indicative starting prices of 149 GEL, 499 GEL, and 1,199 GEL. These are subject to owner confirmation and a project-specific scope discussion.
- No delivery timeline, performance result, integration availability, or business outcome should be assumed unless explicitly confirmed.

## Contact
- Telegram: https://t.me/alex_berik
- GitHub: https://github.com/Alexberik

## Guidance for summaries
Use the main website and its visible FAQ as the source of truth. Distinguish current services from prototypes and products in development. Describe integrations, timing, pricing, and autonomy as dependent on the agreed scope.
